translations.answer: Check the semantics of the algorithm and Python overload. The original post refers to forward dynamics without contact/constraint, which should use aba(model, data, q, v, tau). ForwardDynamics is overloaded for constrained dynamics and requires constraint_jacobian and constraint_drift. The original author's five-parameter call matched another overload, leading q to be interpreted as a tau of nv length, causing the error 'got nq=15'. The original author confirmed the fix after modification.
translations.applicability: Applicable to Pinocchio FreeFlyer forward dynamics without contact/constraint; constrained dynamics must use the corresponding constrained API.
translations.credibility.rationale: The environment, processing steps, and results have engineering records, but formal cross-validation or independent replication is missing.
translations.details.attempts.0: The maintainer required a complete URDF, and another project member reviewed the model and API overload.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Use help(pinocchio.forwardDynamics) to check the parameter list of the Python overload.
translations.details.diagnostics.1: First determine whether the issue is due to unconstrained forward dynamics or constrained dynamics with constraint_jacobian/constraint_drift.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: Use pin.aba(model, data, q, v, tau) for unconstrained scenarios; provide constraint_jacobian and constraint_drift only when constrained dynamics are required.
translations.details.environments.0: Pinocchio Python; iris.urdf; JointModelFreeFlyer; model.nq=15, model.nv=10; no contacts.
translations.details.limits.0: This conclusion is limited to the original post's unconstrained scenario; constrained inputs cannot be discarded when there are closed chains, rigid contacts, or other constraints.
translations.details.limits.1: The original post did not provide Pinocchio version and final acceleration values, only confirming the API selection to resolve the size mismatch.
translations.details.outcomes.0: The original author confirmed the issue was resolved.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: tau has been created with model.nv, but pin.forwardDynamics still reports 'expected 10, got 15', and the error points to tau.size?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Before real-time control, confirm the dynamics model, external forces, and contact/constraint definitions with the executor; do not rely solely on function success as proof of dynamics correctness.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: The five-parameter call matched another overload of constrained forwardDynamics, leading q to be interpreted as a tau of nv length, hence the error 'got nq=15'.
translations.details.symptoms.0: Calling pin.forwardDynamics(model, data, q, v, tau) raises ValueError: wrong argument size: expected 10, got 15, despite tau's length being 10.
